7701.title: Rate UP Hero Pool「FORGE THE FUTURE」end reminder
7701.content:
Dear Player, 

Rate Up Hero Pool「FORGE THE FUTURE」will end soon.
Exclusive points will be converted after the Dreamweaver ends, based on the remaining Exclusive points and redemption conditions. The conversion rules are as follows:
If the remaining Exclusive points exceed 80, they will be automatically redeemed for available items, prioritizing Heroes redemption by default. If you have already redeemed a Hero, the points will be used to redeem Highlight.
If the remaining Exclusive points are less than 80, the points will be converted to Dreamsand at a 1:1 ratio.
Don’t miss the last RATE UP chance for Iron Man!

Thank you for your support for MARVEL Mystic Mayhem!

<align="right">MARVEL Mystic Mayhem Team
